rv.q: So the phrase 'once-in-a-lifetime opportunity' isn't hyperbole when it comes to Jonathan Kent's thrilling account of this Broadway classic.
It is a blistering, yet beautifully detailed performance.
If you like musical theatre, I urge you to see this stunning revival of one of the greatest Broadway musicals.
I'm certain that I'll be in a minority of critics not awarding Gypsy five stars, but I detected a certain hollowness at the core of the story.

Lara Pulver is even better than I remember, watchful and cowed in her early scenes and finally coming out as the burlesque stripper-with-class Gypsy Rose Lee like a butterfly emerging from a chrysalis.
